steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Mr. Malkiewicz!

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Over here. Please, this way, Mr. Malkiewicz!

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Oh, so this is the right place.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Sorry. I'm not too familiar with the roads here, so it took me a while. Sorry to keep you waiting.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: And thank you for agreeing to come pick me up.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: No need to thank me. It's the least I could do.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Please, this way. The venue is in the district across the way.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: R-Right.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Excuse me, but...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: No, never mind. It's nothing.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Today's forum takes place right before the Major's main events... doesn't it?

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Yes, that's right. The General Chamber of Commerce organized this meeting, and while it is a forum, the format is somewhat relaxed. All spokespersons and corporate representatives will be in attendance.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Just show the invitation letter and you'll be let in.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Of course. Of course... I have it right here...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Um, excuse me...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Y-Yes... I'm here. Yes, please, go ahead!

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Pardon me for asking, but do you need any assistance?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Uhh... Excuse me?

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Frightfully sorry. I noticed you've been adjusting your coat...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: If you've run into any trouble, if there is anything I can assist you with at all, please don't hesitate to tell me.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Oh, no... My coat is fine. I mean, no, it's not a huge deal. It's just...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: It's just... I'm not used to it yet... Sorry, this is a personal problem. Please don't worry about it.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Is that so...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: You seem a little nervous?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Yes, just a little. Sorry.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: It's my first time at one of these forums. I'm afraid I'm... still not quite used to this.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: You needn't be so nervous, Spokesman Malkiewicz.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: This forum is a meeting organized by the General Chamber of Commerce. The spokespersons who represent the Chamber are the most esteemed attendees...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Please, try to calm down.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: But... I'm no big shot... certainly not esteemed. I... It was just a coincidence...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Something's gone wrong somewhere. I shouldn't be here...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: You are too humble, sir...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Sorry, I have a phone call.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Please, go ahead.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Hello? This is Malkiewicz... Please go ahead.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Y-Yes, not a problem...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: It fits very well. I don't need anything more. Thank you very much.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Oh, no, I should be thanking you. For sending someone.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: N-No, not at all! He's very kind, and he didn't offend me in any way whatsoever. It only took us so long because I was slow to get ready. Please, don't make things hard for him...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: It's a joke...? Y-Yes... Of course...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Yes, I will be there shortly.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Okay, see you later...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Not at all, sir.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: About what we just discussed—

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: —Agghh!

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Please watch your step, Mr. Malkiewicz!

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: We'll head upstairs via Corridor 4. Please follow me.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Uh, y-yes. Sorry.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: The venue is right ahead. Please make your way there and show the attendant at the door your invitation.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Yes, yes... thanks.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: In that case, please excuse—

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: W-Wait!

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Go ahead, Mr. Malkiewicz.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Actually... I was going to say... I'm not one of those people you'd call esteemed...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: So you really needn't talk to me like this. What I'm trying to say is... just call me Malkiewicz.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: I'm afraid that... wouldn't be appropriate.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: You are the spokesman for the General Chamber of Commerce. As a staff member of the Chamber, I admire your work, and you have my utmost respect...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: If that's it, I really don't deserve your admiration.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: I haven't done anything of importance. Perhaps everyone will realize I'm not cut out for this job after this meeting today.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: And if I got a phone call right now, telling me I'm fired right this minute, I wouldn't be surprised at all.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: You're overthinking it.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: The General Chamber of Commerce must have appointed you spokesman after due consideration... Your abilities were recognized.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: My... what?

steps.name: Deep Male Voice
steps.text: I dialed the spokesman's number, and you answered.

steps.name: Deep Male Voice
steps.text: Therefore, you are the spokesman.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: I... I don't quite think so.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: If I have to give a reason, all I can say is... perhaps it's just something Mr. Czarny came up with on a whim...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: And I was only picked because I happened to be there...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: I am sorry, but I beg your pardon?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: No, it's nothing... Don't worry about it...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Actually...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: I... I've met you before, Mr. Malkiewicz. I was fortunate enough to work on a project with you.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: It's only natural that you don't remember. It happened a long time ago, after all, and it was only a brief collaboration.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Gerald, the team leader...?

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: You remember my name? I'm honored.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: I knew you right away, actually... but, like you said, it was a long time ago. I wasn't sure if it was something I should bring up.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: If I remember correctly, we were reaching out to newcomers for the knightclubs... and we were assigned to the same list of names.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Yes, that's correct.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Do you remember the knights we were assigned to contact?

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: I... I'm sorry, but I don't remember.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: It was a few infected knights...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Right, right. Yes, the Infected.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Please... don't call them that...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: They were just knights, unfortunate enough to get infected.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Yes... Truly unfortunate...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: However, they were fortunate enough to have met you. Thanks to you, they were able to join a proper knightclub. I am sure that was more than those Infected... I mean, the knights could ask for.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: About that...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: I think you might be mistaken. We didn't actually finish that job.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: What...? Hold on, if I recall correctly...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Was it... the time we tried to recruit the Flametail Knight, the Fartooth Knight, those ones?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Do you remember now? That's right. They had just won a few matches... You reminded them to review the contract the knightclub provided them.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: The knights were still young. We couldn't bring ourselves to lie to them.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: It's true that the knightclub's terms for the infected knights weren't very reasonable. I mean, they may seem fair at first glance.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: However, we normally wouldn't go into the fine print for the infected knights.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Right... normally, we wouldn't have done that.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Though this did have to do with the knights' future...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: No one can predict the future.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Just like... Just like you.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: If I hadn't taken a look at your file beforehand, I wouldn't have recognized you.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: I looked in the mirror before I left home this morning. If the person in the mirror hadn't waved with me, I would not have recognized myself.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: ...In any case. Thank you for remembering who I am.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: This is embarrassing to say, but I'm actually still wondering if this is all a dream.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: It's just too surreal...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: If this were a dream, I imagine it must be a pleasant dream.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Y-You think so?

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Is it not?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Well... I don't think it's necessarily one...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: To tell the truth, I think I might feel more terrified than anything else.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Terrified?

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: What are you terrified of?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Many, many things. I hardly get any sleep, and regardless of whether all this is real or fake, nothing good will come of it... The only difference it makes is that things are bad in entirely different ways.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: The way you think is... peculiar.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: R-Really...?

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Yes. After all, you are experiencing quite the rags to riches story.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: From a lowly office worker, you rose to the top and joined the big leagues... I think most of us have dreamt of something similar.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: It's something that everyone has fantasized... Indeed...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: What's so bad about it? It's not often that dreams actually come true.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Luck was on your side, Mr. Malkiewicz.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: But I didn't really... I...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Do you really understand? There are many who envy you for what you have gone through.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: To tell the truth—At the very least, I envy you very much.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Maybe... this is why...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: I beg your pardon?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Uhh, I mean, perhaps this is what's most terrifying.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: It's all going too well, too natural, and it's all too structured... It all happened way too quickly.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Just two days ago, I was worried I couldn't pay rent for the month. I wasn't able to convince Maria Nearl to join our knightclub, and I was most likely going to get a pay cut.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: That was when I ran into Mr. Czarny... He was very busy during the Major's preliminaries, and I helped run some errands.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: And then...?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: And then I took a phone call.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: A phone call?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: A phone call.

steps.name: Bold Female Voice
steps.text: From now on, you no longer belong to the Słoma Food Company, nor the Mieszko Group——Please keep in mind at all times that you are representing the General Chamber of Commerce.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Wait...! I don't want to be...!

steps.name: Bold Female Voice
steps.text: You have no right to ask questions.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: I-I don't think...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: No, I... I understand...

steps.name: Bold Female Voice
steps.text: Very good. I wish you the best of luck.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: There was no way I could possibly understand...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Even though, from head to heels, this getup is specially tailored to make me a big deal, that doesn't mean I've really become one...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Actually, I don't think this outfit suits me at all.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Nonsense... It looks great on you.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: This may come off as rude... but I ask you to forgive me in light of us having worked together in the past.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: What is it? Please...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: A bit of advice, Mr. Malkiewicz.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: As someone whom fortune has smiled upon, you should try to refrain from sharing your feelings to those who, like me, are less fortunate.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: I really wish to empathize with the way you feel, but alas...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: I can't.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: There are many who wish to be in your position, myself included, but we aren't so fortunate.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Do you understand?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: I do... but still...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Perhaps you do have your worries. You feel fear, anxiety, and hesitation... but no matter what you are feeling...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: You are well groomed and dressed to kill, you have the invitation in your hand, and you are walking inside this building as the spokesman for the General Chamber of Commerce.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Regardless of what you think yourself, in the eyes of everyone else, you are very much a big deal.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: The venue is straight ahead, Mr. Malkiewicz. Please excuse me.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Wait...!

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: I wish you a pleasant day.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: I heard you were once an entrepreneur, Mr. Malkiewicz?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Y-Yes... I founded a company with a friend before. A very small one...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: It must have been a success?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: No, not at all. You flatter me.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: You're too humble! If we ever get the chance, please do share with us your stories of entrepreneurship.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Your thoughts on the treatment of the independent knights was thought-provoking too...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Right, would you like a drink? Let me get you—

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: W-Watch out!

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: M-My apologies... I am deeply sorry, Mr. Malkiewicz!

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: No, it's okay. No big deal. Please don't mind it at all...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: My god, your clothes—

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Clothes...? Uhh...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Oh, the wine...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: I-I'm terribly sorry!

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: I-I'll fetch you some towels right away!

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: No, no. It's okay. I'm fine.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Uh, thanks...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Please wait a moment. Don't move. I'll wipe it clean—

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Please, you don't have to...! I-I can do it myself!

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Please take your coat off. I'm afraid it will be difficult to get the stain out. I will arrange for someone to get it dry cleaned.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Take my coat off...?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Oh... and if you are not satisfied with that, I can pay you for the coat...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Mr. Malkiewicz? Are you alright, Mr. Malkiewicz?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: N-No, thank you... It's okay. This is good enough. Please don't pay me anything!

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Huh? But...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: It's no problem. I mean it... Thank you.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: This will do... I'm sorry, I was in a bit of a daze...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: It happens. I understand. You don't seem very well, though. Perhaps you are a little exhausted?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Were you thinking about work just now?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Uh... I suppose so...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: I was just thinking about some advice I got from a friend.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: I guess he was right. It turns out my own thoughts don't matter, a lot of the time...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Uh, what do you mean...?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Don't worry about it, please. I'm talking to myself, that's all.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: It's just... even if I don't think I'm a big deal...

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: It looks like... I'm stuck wearing these suits for a while.
